about.description: HAWConnect is an open-source campus app for HAW Hamburg, maintained by students. Find your imported timetable, Hamburg cafeteria menus, campus maps, semester dates, events, clubs and useful university links in one place.
about.independence: An independent student project. HAWConnect is not officially endorsed by HAW Hamburg.
